outputs.explanation: Panel shows a single spatial-transcriptomic cluster map of one SNL lung section; it is a descriptive/representative image, not a quantitative summary derived from multiple replicates, so replicate reporting does not apply.
Panel is an H&E image with manual region annotation of the same single lung section shown in A; it presents no averaged/statistical data requiring replicate reporting.
Panel shows H&E and spatial expression maps (Tmprss11b, Trp63, Hnf4a) from the same single tissue section; this is a spatial visualization, not a replicated quantitative measurement.

replicate_statements: The nominal P and FDR values were obtained from the “GSEA Preranked” tool (from Broad Institute) using a weighted scoring scheme.
statistical significance was determined by bootstrapping with 1000 permutations
outputs.explanation: GSEA plots report NES, FDR, and P values (i.e., claim statistical significance) comparing T11b-high (S1&S2) versus T11b-low (S3) regions, but the caption never states how many biological units (e.g., spots, sections, or animals) underlie each group, nor what type of replicate they represent. The mentioned '1000 permutations' is a resampling procedure for the null distribution, not a report of biological/technical replicate number.

replicate_statements: Differential gene expression was calculated using Seurat’s FindAllMarkers function, and direct comparisons between two classes and corresponding P values were obtained using Seurat’s FindMarkers function with the Wilcoxon rank-sum test with Bonferroni P value correction.
outputs.explanation: Bar graph reports log2 fold-change values with associated P values from a Wilcoxon rank-sum test comparing Tmprss11b-high versus -low LUSC spots/regions, but the caption does not state the number of replicates (e.g., spots, sections, or animals) compared, nor the type of unit each data point represents.
